chunks: Zurārah and Bukayr narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
There is no zakat on gemstones and similar items, even if they are abundant.

key_terms.أَشْبَاهِهِ: similar items of the same kind
key_terms.زَكَاةٌ: the obligatory alms-tax due on specified categories of wealth

ai.seo_question: Is zakat obligatory on gemstones and jewelry in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that gemstones and similar valuables are not subject to zakat. Its significance is in clarifying the categories of wealth upon which zakat is obligatory, excluding jewels even when they are present in large amounts.
